title: First Merchants Corp Sells 4,523 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) -
text:
First Merchants Corp trimmed its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.8% during the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 73,367 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 4,523 Apple makes up approximately 2.4% of First Merchants Corp’s holdings, making the stock its 5th biggest holding. First Merchants Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $13,580,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Several other and hedge funds have also recently modified their holdings of the company. Ironwood Investment Counsel LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.3% during the 2nd quarter. Ironwood Investment Counsel LLC now owns 35,665 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,601,000 after acquiring an additional 466 shares in the last quarter. Gradient Capital Advisors LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 5.3% during the 2nd quarter. Gradient Capital Advisors LLC now owns 24,831 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,597,000 after acquiring an additional 1,239 shares in the last quarter. Tealwood Asset Management Inc. purchased a new stake in shares of Apple during the 2nd quarter worth approximately $2,262,000. Greenwich Wealth Management LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 6.2% during the 2nd quarter. Greenwich Wealth Management LLC now owns 69,490 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,863,000 after acquiring an additional 4,055 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Meritage Portfolio Management raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 5.3% during the 2nd quarter. Meritage Portfolio Management now owns 195,186 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $36,131,000 after acquiring an additional 9,853 shares in the last quarter. 58.44% of the stock is currently owned by and hedge funds.
